# Ezekiel Bible Institute

> Ezekiel Bible Institute is an evangelical, interdenominational Bible school at Christian Service Church, East Legon, Accra, Ghana. Founded in 2001, it trains pastors, missionaries and church leaders through certificate, diploma and degree programmes in Bible, theology and ministry. Students study on campus in East Legon, with on-site hostel accommodation, or online from anywhere. Ghanaian and international students are welcome.

## Key facts

- Location: Christian Service Church, East Legon, Accra, Greater Accra Region, Ghana
- Founded: 2001
- Levels: Certificate, Diploma, Bachelor, Master, Doctor of Ministry, PhD
- Study: on campus in East Legon, Accra
- Students: Ghanaian and international; teaching is in English
- Accommodation: student hostel on site, furnished shared rooms, separate wings for men and women
- Intakes: January and September. January 2027 applications close 30 November 2026
- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 16:30 GMT

## Programmes (curriculum framework)

Motto: "Presenting every believer mature in Christ." (Colossians 1:28)
Formation pathway: Know Christ, understand truth, become like Christ, serve faithfully, multiply.
Four formation dimensions: knowledge, character, competence, calling.

1. Certificate in Christian Foundations: 1 year, 2 semesters (courses CF 101 to CF 108)
2. Diploma in Christian Ministry & Biblical Studies: 1 year, 2 semesters (DM 201 to DM 208)
3. Bachelor of Theology / Christian Ministry: 3 years, 6 semesters (BT 301 to BT 512, including Biblical Greek and an elective in Hebrew)
4. Master of Theology / Christian Ministry: 2 years, 4 semesters, with specialisations in Biblical Studies, Theology, Christian Ministry, or Church Structure & Administration, and a thesis
5. Doctor of Ministry (DMin): 3 years, 6 semesters, ending in a doctoral ministry project and portfolio
6. PhD in Biblical & Theological Studies: 3 to 5 years, with tracks in Old Testament, New Testament, Systematic Theology, Historical Theology and Practical Theology, and a dissertation

Every level includes a ministry practicum and portfolio.
Full course list: https://ezekiel-bible-school.vercel.app/curriculum
Curriculum PDF: https://ezekiel-bible-school.vercel.app/ezekiel-bible-institute-curriculum.pdf
